review.outcome: <OK when you reviewed the plan, ERROR when the review could not be run>
missingFiles: <only when outcome is ERROR: the exact paths you could not read. Empty otherwise.>
review.message: <only when outcome is ERROR: why the review did not happen. Empty otherwise.>

issues.sectionId: <the id of the plan section this issue is in, exactly as the plan spells it>
issues.evidence: <repo-relative path and the line numbers you read, as path/to/file.ts:12-40>
issues.planAsserts: <quote or close paraphrase of what the plan says>

fixes.sectionId: <the id of the section this fix repairs; one fix per issue, same order>
fixes.fix: <the concrete edit to make to that section, written as an instruction>
fixes.durableBecause: <why this will not regress the same way>
